title: Target's New 'Versatile' Product Rivals a Fan-Favorite Dyson Style Almost 5x the Price - NewsBreak
text: Parade aims to feature only the best products and services. If you buy something via one of our links, we may earn a commission. The Dyson Airwrap took the Internet by storm since its original launch in 2018. The Airwap quickly became a fan favorite thanks to its various attachments that gave users the opportunity to create countless hair styles, from bouncy curls to silky blowouts. Since then, the iconic hair styler has released two new models , one in 2022 and the most recent in 2024. Despite the new features on each edition, one thing that has not changed among these Dyson hair tools, is the high price point of almost $600. Yeah. It is definitely not what one would consider cheap. 🎬 SIGN UP for Parade's Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 Luckily, other brands have taken note of the Dyson Airwap's versatility and have attempted to recreate the vast offerings of the hair tool on their own. Take, for example, the InfinitPRO by Conair DigitalAIRE Plus Straightener. Like the Dyson Airwrap, the Conair hair tool features multiple styling attachments for infinite styling options. Target However, compared to the Dyson Airwrap, Conair's version only retails for $130 at Target, making it almost five times less expensive. Related: Shoppers are Racing to Target to Get Their Hands on This 'Phenomenal' Super Serum They Say Deliver the 'Best Hydrated Glow' Conair's InfinitiPRO includes five different brush and dryer attachments. You can smooth strands, curl hair and more. The attachments deliver 1200 watts of drying power but wont' damage hair either, which is always a win. Like the Dyson Airwrap, you can choose between three different temperature settings on the Conair InfinitPRO–cold, warm and hot–as well as two speed settings (low and high). And, like the Airwrap, set your style with the cool shot function. What's more, the Conair InfinitePro at Target comes equipped with a heat-resistant drawstring bag to keep all of the attachments and base tool nice and organized.
